candidates.headline: 15% off on complementary accessories
candidates.rationale: Boost cross‑sell by giving customers a discount on items that pair well with their recent purchases.

candidates.headline: Rs 75 off your next order
candidates.rationale: Encourage customers to add complementary products by offering a fixed cash discount.

candidates.rationale: Cross‑sell by bundling a popular item with a related SKU at no extra cost, increasing basket size.

candidates.headline: 10% loyalty credit on complementary items
candidates.rationale: Reward repeat shoppers with credit that applies to cross‑sell products, reinforcing loyalty.

candidates.headline: Your cart still has items waiting!
candidates.rationale: Prompt customers to complete their purchase without offering a discount, maintaining margin.
